name: Fernando Navarrete Rojas - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the European Semester for economic policy coordination 2025
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its views on how the EU should coordinate national economic and budget policies in 2025. It asks for responsible spending, more investment in competitiveness, energy and defence, and better use of EU money. It wants the new budget rules applied fairly to all countries, and warns that delays and weak follow-through on country recommendations undermine trust. It is an opinion only; it does not change any law.

- New budget rules need fair, transparent application; several countries were late submitting plans.
- Affects all member states' budgets, especially the eight with excessive deficits.
- Next: Parliament sends its views to the Council and Commission for the 2025 coordination round.
